This page is under construction.

The ND-HNC provides hardware and infrastructure to support research activities. Please see below for detailed instructions on how to use these resources:

| Resource | Type | Purpose |
|----------|------|-------------|
| [CorpFS](operate/corpfs.qmd) | File System | Centralize experiment protocols and participant response data. |
| [MRI Simulator](operate/mock.qmd) | Equipment | Prepare participants to contribute MRI data. |
| [SyncBox](operate/nnl_syncbox.qmd) | Equipment | Capture fMRI synchronization pulse and participant responses. |
| NordicNeuroLab | Equipment | Deploy functional MRI paradigms and capture participant responses. |
| Stimulus Control | Computer | Deploy lab-specific MRI paradigms. |
| DICOM Management | Computer | Capture, organize, and send DICOM files to an appropriate location. |
